name: tanka
description: A single-skill marketplace: tanka, a brevity pass that summarises a long document in five lines and cuts the body to what a reader needs.

plugins.name: tanka
plugins.description: Cut a long document to what a reader needs, put a five-line summary on top they can act on, and strip the signatures of machine-written prose. Kills over-communication: restatement, implied consequences spelled out, background before the ask. Carries the house-style register pass too: Australian English, sentence case, no em dashes, plain verbs. Pairs with the human-voice skill for the full machine-tells catalogue.
